Figure 2: Efficiency-Accuracy trade-off comparison of ToMe, ToFu, and Ours on ViT-B. The top plot shows compression rate versus Top-1 accuracy, and the bottom plot shows peak memory (GB) versus Top-1 accuracy. A lower compression rate indicates stronger token reduction.

Table 1: Comparison of Accuracy and Throughput on ImageNet-1K across various backbones and reduction rates (𝑟 ) using plug-and-play token reduction modules. For ViT-L, token reduction is applied only to the first 12 layers using the same layer-wise schedule as ViT-B and DeiT-B.

Figure 1: Overall architecture of the proposed algorithm. At each stage, the tokens are first divided into two groups. Then, in the early layers, token reduction is performed by ranking tokens using a redundancy-similarity aware metric, while in the late layers, token reduction is performed using an importance-similarity aware metric. Num. indicates the number of destination tokens whose similarity exceeds the threshold, and the equations shown represent the metrics used for ranking.
